purpose: Post-observation diagnostic: test whether ordered English in an unrelated archived work can also beat the original 16 shuffled-key maxima. This is not a preregistered significance test.
normalization: Join text fields of all 50 paragraphs in stored order with a space, uppercase, retain ASCII A-Z. Greedily consume the longest canonical GP Latin label across erased word boundaries; for unmapped V,K,Z,Q use aliases U,C,S,C (indices 1,5,15,5). This matches the pinned manifesto GP-greedy encoder. Every parsed GP rune supplies one key residue.
targets_and_scoring: Exactly the 55 nonempty LP2-00–55 pages and whole-page, every fitting key offset, both signs and English quadgram model pinned by plan.json. No wrap or reset.
comparison: For each of four nonoverlapping Emerson windows, report the global best score against the original solved-reading maximum and shuffled-key maxima. No p-value or independent-trial claim.
timing: Frozen after original solved-reading results were inspected, before this diagnostic was run.
